properties.decision:
DECIDED 2026-08-24 by Anthony, choosing "ask, don't block" after being walked through the finding below. This settles the HOW that `dec:idea-how-does-the-graph-learn-what-a-session-invalidated` left open with six costed options and none chosen.

═══ THE FINDING THAT REFRAMED THE QUESTION ═══

🛑 **OPTION C WAS ALREADY BUILT, AND HAD NEVER ONCE BEEN USED.** `INVALIDATES` — "the record that did the work names the finding it answered" — shipped in PR #321 on 2026-08-23 WITH its reader, deliberately, so the marker would not become a comment nobody consults. Measured 2026-08-24, one day later, with the tool served the whole time:

    INVALIDATES edges in the graph:  0

Not one, by anybody. So the open question was never "which of six mechanisms" — five of them were ways to make the SIXTH get used, and the sixth already existed.

⭐⭐ **WHY, PRECISELY.** A design's vocabulary reaches real work only with THREE LEGS — a typed TOOL, an INSTRUCTION that names it, and a COMPUTATION THAT NOTICES ITS ABSENCE. Measured:
  • TOOL — ✅ `invalidates`, served since 07:32 that day.
  • INSTRUCTION — ❌ exactly one skill mentioned it (`where-am-i`) and only the READ side. Not capture-session, not impact-check, not revise-design, not AGENTS.md.
  • ABSENCE DETECTOR — ❌ nothing anywhere.

Two of three legs missing is a complete explanation for zero uses, and it needs no theory about discipline.

═══ WHAT THIS DECIDES ═══

BUILD THE TWO MISSING LEGS. Add no seventh mechanism.
  • **The computation:** `unclaimed_findings` — given the ChangeEvent ids a session recorded, the OPEN observations their changed subjects carry that nobody has claimed.
  • **The instruction:** `capture-session` test 7 and `impact-check` step 4 name the tool and the moment.
  • **The delivery:** the Stop hook's async probe asks it and RIDES ALONG on a nudge already firing, or is carried to the next SessionStart.

═══ ASK, DON'T BLOCK — Anthony's word, and the restraint is the design ═══

The ask NEVER arms an interruption of its own. It only ever appends to a message already being sent. His reasoning as offered and accepted: a brand-new trigger keyed on a computation nobody has field-tested is exactly the thing that becomes wallpaper, and it can be upgraded once the shortlist has been seen to be right.

🛑 THE HONEST COST OF THAT CHOICE, stated rather than glossed: a Stop hook that does not block reaches the TRANSCRIPT, not the agent. The two paths that genuinely reach an agent are the ride-along and the next SessionStart. If this must reach an agent mid-session every time, blocking is the only mechanism that does.

═══ WHY A SESSION-SIZED QUESTION, AND THE NUMBER THAT DECIDED IT ═══

Option A's recorded objection was fatal and correct: 200 findings on day one is wallpaper, and a consumer abandoned reflow2 over exactly that. Scoped to the events one session wrote, measured over all 639 ChangeEvents on this design: **71% touch no open observation at all; the median when one is touched is 1.**

⚠️ AND THE FIRST VERSION OF THAT NUMBER WAS WRONG IN THE FLATTERING DIRECTION — 78%, measured before the computation read `subject_id`, i.e. against the 56% of observations reachable by edge alone. Widening the reach to 97% necessarily lengthened the shortlists. Honest figures: 71% silent, median 1, mean 4.3, p90 13, max 40. **A measurement taken against a narrower implementation than the one that shipped is not evidence about the one that shipped.**

═══ WHAT IT MUST NOT BECOME ═══

🛑 IT DOES NOT REVERSE `dec:verification-freshness-not-a-gap` (accepted 2026-07-26, read before this was written). That rules a stale-looking CHECK a STANDING PROPERTY which would fire on every legitimate refactor. So: TemporalFacts only, never Verifications — a dated OBSERVATION is asserted once and re-derived by nothing — and this is deliberately NOT a gap source. It answers when asked and appears in no list that must reach zero.

═══ OPTIONS NOT TAKEN ═══
D (a "this answers X" field on `record_change`) — DECLINED. At write time nobody can know which of 270 observations they touched without searching; the computation does it afterwards for free, and the busiest write in the loop keeps its shape.
F (do nothing) — REFUTED by two sightings plus `fact:twelve-records-that-still-read-confident`.
B — kept, as the manual path, now pointed at the computation instead of at `search_design`.
properties.name: DECIDED — build the two MISSING LEGS, not a seventh mechanism: the edge already existed and had never once been drawn
properties.rationale:
Recorded as its own node because it answers a different question from the brainstorm it settles: that one asked WHICH mechanism, and the measurement showed the mechanism already existed and was inert. The reframing is the part worth keeping — five of six options were ways to make the sixth get used.

⭐ THE GENERAL LESSON, and it is bigger than this feature: shipping a typed tool WITH its reader was not enough, and #321 did that carefully and on purpose. What was missing was anything that noticed the tool was never used. A vocabulary can be reachable, documented in its own node, wired to a reader, and still dead — and nothing in the loop reports a zero-use edge. That is worth checking for every edge type this design has added.
